['Unilever Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Unilever Deutschland GmbH is a subsidiary of Unilever, a multinational consumer goods company. Unilever Deutschland GmbH operates in the consumer goods industry and offers a wide range of products including food, beverages, cleaning agents, and personal care products.

['ElringKlinger AG '].company_description: ElringKlinger AG is a German automotive supplier and car spare parts manufacturer. It serves as a worldwide development partner and original equipment supplier of cylinder-head and specialty gaskets, plastic housing modules, shielding components for engine, transmission, exhaust systems and underbody, exhaust gas purification technology as well as battery and fuel cell components. The company provides its products to almost all of the world's vehicle and engine manufacturers. ElringKlinger employs roughly 9,724 people in 45 locations worldwide.
